annotations.title: Set the price of specific nights

description: Gives its own price per night to one night or a range (e.g. Christmas), for one unit or (without unit_id) for every unit. It wins over seasons and the base price. weekdays limits it to some days of the week, e.g. ["fri","sat"] for weekends in July. Existing bookings keep their agreed total. For one night, send only from. Acts on one venue, given its address and access key.

address.description: The venue’s address name, the "name" in name.bookare.app.

to.description: Last night (inclusive), YYYY-MM-DD. Default: same as from.

unit_id.description: Leave out to set it on every unit.

weekdays.description: Optional: only these nights of the week.

name: set_nightly_price
title: Set the price of specific nights
